name: 数据标注实训云
description: 面向教学实训的多模态数据标注工作台，支持自有素材、PDF 文字导入、预设实训项目和已保存项目续标。

composer.prompt: 使用数据标注实训云插件时，不要查找素材、索要文件路径或从对话创建标注任务。首次使用直接调用 open-workbench，再立即用 ipollowork_browser_open_url 在右侧内置浏览器打开返回地址，不要在对话中显示带令牌的原始地址。用户可以在工作台上传自己的图片、视频、音频，直接输入文字或从 PDF 提取文字，也可以直接选择插件内置实训项目。只有用户明确要求查看已保存项目或统计已保存标注时，才使用 list-projects 和 get-project；这些对话操作只读，不能修改右侧标注。
suggestions: 列出我最近保存的标注项目。
读取最近的项目，统计已保存标注。

permissions.reason: 仅在本机 127.0.0.1 启动数据标注实训页面和标注接口。
加载用户在插件页面中上传并保存的图片和标注。
将标注结果保存到当前工作区的插件专属目录。

en.name: Data Annotation Training Cloud
en.description: A multimodal data annotation workbench for teaching and training, with user-owned media, PDF text import, prepared exercises, and resumable saved projects.

composer.prompt: When using Data Annotation Training Cloud, do not search for media, request file paths, or create annotation tasks from chat. On first use, call open-workbench and immediately open the returned URL in the right-side in-app browser without showing the token-bearing URL in chat. Users upload their own images, video, and audio, enter text directly or extract text from PDF files, or choose a prepared exercise in the workbench. Only use list-projects and get-project when the user explicitly asks to inspect saved projects or summarize saved annotations. These chat actions are read-only and cannot change annotations in the workbench.

labelu-data-annotation-workflow.label: Data Annotation Training Workflow
